citations.claim: first violation: controller force 25.57 exceeds fmax 5.796 at final step
one step earlier force was clamped exactly at fmax, showing clamp normally works
two steps earlier force also clamped at fmax

counterfactual.change: Lowered kp from 27.56 to 1.0 only, so raw velocity-error demand stays below fmax and the clamp is never stressed; same 132 steps pass.

explanation: Force clamp works on most steps (forces pinned exactly at fmax=5.796 at steps 130-131) but is bypassed intermittently, emitting raw kp*velocity-error demand (25.57 at step 132, ~4.4x limit). Lowering kp removes the violation because raw demand never exceeds fmax. Likely cause: clamping applied on outer step but substepped physics integration (substeps_in_step=2) recomputes/applies unclamped force on a substep.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body hovers just below the green waypoint with almost no motion through steps 129 to 131. At step 132 it suddenly jumps downward away from the waypoint.
